notifications.superhiveAuthDetail: The stored API token was rejected — reconnect in Settings.
activity.emptyHint: Changes made outside the launcher — like an add-on getting disabled or a preference changed directly in Blender — will show up here.
settings.desktopOnlyHint: These settings need filesystem access — open the Blender Hub window.
settings.startupHint: Start Blender Hub automatically when you sign in to this computer. With the minimized option on, an autostarted launch waits in the tray instead of opening the window.
settings.trayHint: Keep Blender Hub running in the system tray — handy while a download or install is in progress. Click the tray icon to bring the window back.
settings.projectFoldersHint: Folders scanned for .blend files on the Projects page.
settings.trackedFilesHint: Single .blend files tracked outside the folders above. Removing an entry does not touch the file.
settings.removeMissingProjectsHint: Drops tracked project files that can no longer be found on disk from the list.
settings.removeMissingProjectsConfirmMes: Remove {count} missing project(s) from the list? The files already can’t be found on disk — this just stops tracking them.
settings.installFolderHint: Where new Blender versions get installed. Already-installed versions stay where they are.
settings.downloadFolderHint: Where build archives download to before extraction. Cleared automatically after each install.
settings.libraryFolderHint: Where the launcher keeps copies of your add-on files so they survive removing Blender versions. Changing the folder moves the stored files.
settings.assetLibraryHint: One shared asset library for every installed Blender version. Brushes, materials, node groups and poses saved here are available everywhere and travel with the launcher.
settings.assetLibraryEnable: Register in all installed Blender versions
settings.assetLibraryNoVersions: No installed Blender 3.0+ versions to register in yet.
settings.assetLibraryRemoveLeftover: Could not remove the library from: {versions}. Close Blender and toggle the library on and off again to retry.
settings.assetLibraryRowStale: folder path is outdated — will be fixed
settings.assetLibraryRowUserRemoved: removed by you in Blender — Fix re-adds it
settings.assetLibraryRowRunning: Blender is running, will retry later
settings.assetLibraryRowNoUserpref: never launched yet — registered after its first run
settings.assetLibraryHowToText:
1. In Blender, right-click an object, material or node group → Mark as Asset.
2. Save the .blend file into this folder (File → Save As).
3. It appears in the Asset Browser under “Blender Hub” in every version.
Brushes (Blender 4.3+): in the brush asset menu choose Save As Asset and pick “Blender Hub”.
settings.assetLibraryDisableMessage: Remove the “Blender Hub” library from Blender preferences in all versions? Files in the assets folder are never deleted either way.
settings.superhiveHint: Paste your Superhive API token to install and update purchased extensions from the launcher. It is stored encrypted by your operating system — never in plain text.
settings.superhiveUnavailable: Secure storage is unavailable on this system, so the token cannot be saved safely.
settings.superhiveWhereToken: Where do I find my token?
settings.storageHint: How much disk each part of the launcher’s data folder uses. Installed Blender builds usually dominate.
settings.updatesHint: Blender Hub checks its GitHub releases for a newer version. Updating swaps just the launcher file — the data folder with your builds and settings stays untouched.
settings.updatesUpToDate: You are on the latest version.
settings.updatesReady: Update downloaded and verified — restart to apply it.
settings.updatesManualOnly: This build can’t replace itself — grab the new version from the releases page.
settings.notificationsHint: What the bell in the title bar reports. Checks run quietly in the background a few times a day.
settings.themesHint: Colors of the launcher interface. Themes live as JSON files in the launcher's data folder — duplicate a preset, tweak the colors and share the file.
settings.themesDeleteConfirmMessage: Delete “{name}”? The file is moved to the trash.
settings.colorPickerEyedropper: Pick a color from the screen
drop.overlayHint: Projects (.blend), add-ons (.zip, .py or an extension link), Blender build archives
drop.itemAddon: Add-on — will be stored in the library
drop.itemAddonUrl: Extension link — will be downloaded into the library
drop.itemFolder: Folders are not supported — drop individual files
drop.desktopOnly: Drag and drop works in the desktop app window
syncOffer.title: Blender {version} installed
syncOffer.message: This is a new version — it starts with no preferences or add-ons of its own. Bring them over?
syncOffer.settingsHint: Preferences, startup file, bookmarks, presets, scripts, datafiles — from Blender {source}.
syncOffer.addonsHintDefault: Add-ons enabled in every version they are installed in (the fully checked rows on Add-ons), each carried from its newest copy.
runningGate.title: Blender is still running
runningGate.message: These versions are open right now. A running Blender re-saves its own settings on top of the changes, silently undoing them — close it to continue.
runningGate.autoCheck: Continues automatically once they are closed — rechecking every couple of seconds.
runningGate.closeRequested: Close requested — the windows are stacked on top: deal with the top one and the next is right beneath it. Files with unsaved changes get Blender's own save prompt.
runningGate.askCloseHint: Raises every window into a stack and sends each a normal close request — Blender itself asks what to do with unsaved files, nothing is force-killed
runningGate.proceedAnywayHint: Risky: the running Blender can overwrite the result
installs.title: Installs
installs.locateHint: Add existing Blender installations — pick a folder, every build inside is detected
installs.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app window
installs.refreshHint: Re-check the builds catalog and installed list
installs.previewBanner: Browser preview — builds are listed read-only. Installing, launching and uninstalling work in the desktop app window.
installs.noExperimentalBuilds: No experimental builds on the official buildbot right now — they will appear here automatically when Blender developers publish some.
installs.noProjectsUseVersion: No projects use this version yet
installs.updateHint: Install {build} and move this copy to the recycle bin
installs.preReleaseInstallHint: Release candidate — the current stable of this series is {version}
installs.busyUpdating: This copy is being replaced by the update
installs.candidateInstallMessage: Blender {version} is a release candidate. Replacing moves the installed {current} to the trash; keeping both installs it side by side.
installs.upgradeMessage: Blender {version} supersedes the installed {current}. Replacing moves {current} to the trash; keeping both installs it side by side.
installs.downgradeMessage: Blender {version} is older than the installed {current}. Replacing moves {current} to the trash; keeping both installs it side by side.
installs.alreadyInstalled: Blender {version} ({cycle}) is already installed — remove the existing copy first to reinstall it.
installs.confirmUninstallMessage: Uninstall Blender {version} ({cycle})? Its files will be moved to the trash.
installs.confirmRemoveMessage: Remove Blender {version} from the list? Files on disk are not touched.
installs.locateAddedSomeSkipped: Added {count} installation(s). Already installed, so not added: {names}.
projects.title: Projects
projects.desktopOnlyHint: Browsing local .blend files needs filesystem access — open the Blender Hub window.
projects.emptyHint: Use Add to point the launcher at a folder or a single .blend file, or New project to create a fresh file in the version you choose.
projects.name: Name
projects.favoriteEmpty: {path} — no projects in it right now
projects.folderCreateHint: It shows up dimmed until a project lands in it. Right-click hides it again.
projects.folderRenameHint: The folder is renamed on disk. Projects inside keep their place in the list.
projects.folderDeleteMessage: Send "{path}" to the trash with everything in it, including {count} project(s)?
projects.removeAllMissingMessage: Remove all {count} missing projects from the list? Files on disk are not touched — a file that shows up in a project folder again comes back on its own.
projects.relinkNoneFound: No files with matching names were found in the selected folder.
projects.folderUnavailableHint: It may have been moved or renamed, or its drive is offline. Its projects are hidden until the folder is back.
projects.removeFolderMessage: Stop tracking "{path}"? Its projects disappear from the list; files on disk are not touched. Adding the folder again brings them back.
projects.versionMismatch: This project was made in Blender {fileVersion}. Blender {selectedVersion} is a different version.
projects.openDifferentVersionMessage: This project was saved in Blender {fileVersion}. Opening it in Blender {buildVersion} may upgrade the file and change how it behaves — this can be hard to undo. Consider saving a backup first.
projects.removeFromListMessage: Remove "{name}" from the list? The file is missing from disk, so only its entry goes away.
projects.untrackFileMessage: Remove "{name}" from the list? The file stays on disk — adding it again brings it back.
projects.deleteFileMessage: Delete "{name}" from disk? It will be moved to the trash.
projects.renameHint: The file on disk is renamed. The .blend extension is kept automatically.
sync.componentPreferencesHint: userpref.blend — theme, keymap, input, paths. Enabled add-ons stay per version
sync.componentStartupHint: startup.blend — the scene every new session opens with
sync.componentBookmarksHint: bookmarks.txt — the [Recent] folder history is ignored
sync.componentPresetsHint: scripts/presets — saved themes, keymaps, render presets
sync.faceTitlePush: Staged to overwrite with the source on Apply. Click to cancel.
sync.faceTitleNew: Will link and copy from the source on Apply. Click to cancel.
sync.faceTitleUnlink: Will be unlinked on Apply (files stay as they are). Click to cancel.
sync.faceTitleSourceChanged: The source changed since the last sync — will update on Apply. Click to unlink.
sync.faceTitleInSync: In sync with the source. Click to unlink.
sync.faceTitleTargetChanged: Changed in that version since the last sync — resolve it in the changes panel above. Click to unlink.
sync.faceTitleConflict: Both this version and the source changed since the last sync — resolve it in the changes panel above. Click to unlink.
sync.cellClickToLinkPresent: {info} — click to link: keeps following Blender {source}
sync.cellClickToLinkAbsent: Click to link: copies from Blender {source} and keeps following it
sync.applyBackupNotice: Files being replaced are backed up first (see Backups below). Close any running Blender of these versions first — otherwise it may overwrite the copied settings when it exits.
sync.alsoUnlinksOne: Also unlinks {count} cell — they stop being tracked; no files change.
sync.alsoUnlinksMany: Also unlinks {count} cells — they stop being tracked; no files change.
sync.olderThanSourceWarning: Blender {versions} — older than the source: settings from a newer version may not fully apply there.
sync.addonsNotAffected: Add-ons are not affected: each version keeps its own enabled-add-on list. Installing and enabling add-ons lives on the Add-ons tab.
sync.copyIntoSourceMessage: {component} of Blender {minor} will replace the source's (Blender {source}) copy — other linked versions will then show an update on the next Apply. The source's current files are backed up first. Close any running Blender {source} first.
sync.restoreDialogMessage: {components} of Blender {minor} will be replaced with this backup from {date}. The current files are snapshotted first, so the restore itself can be undone. Close any running Blender {minor} first.
sync.deleteBackupMessage: The snapshot of Blender {minor} from {date} moves to the OS trash.
sync.discardHint: Undo the link clicks made since the last scan and cancel staged overwrites — established links stay
sync.rescanHint: Re-read every version’s settings folders and check for changes
sync.desktopOnlyHint: Available in the desktop app window
sync.autoApplyHint: After a rescan, components changed in the source are copied to their linked versions without pressing Apply. Versions with Blender running are skipped until it closes; every replaced file is still backed up. New links, conflicts and your staged clicks keep the manual Apply.
sync.browserPreviewNotice: Browser preview — reading and copying Blender settings needs filesystem access, which only works in the desktop app window.
sync.overwriteFromSourceHint: Discard that version's changes: the source's copy replaces them on Apply (backed up first)
sync.copyIntoSourceHint: Adopt that version's changes: copy them into the source, other versions update on the next Apply
sync.scanIntro: Scan reads which settings each Blender version has on disk.
sync.noSettingsFound: No Blender settings found — install a version on the Installs tab, or launch Blender once so it creates its settings folder.
sync.portableInstallSuffix: · portable install (settings live next to it)
sync.noInstalledBuildHint: No installed build — its settings can still be used as a source
sync.sourceDotTitle: Settings source — linked versions copy their settings from here
sync.installHint: Open Installs with the {minor} builds ready to install
sync.locateHint: Point at a folder with an existing Blender install to add it
sync.keepLinkedEverywhereHint: Keep this component linked in every version
sync.notPresentInSourceHint: Not present in the source version
sync.matrixHelpSuffix: by clicking the circles — a row's checkbox links every version at once. Apply copies the linked settings; every replaced file is backed up automatically. Add-ons are never touched — they live on the Add-ons tab.
sync.backupsEmpty: Every Apply and Restore first snapshots the files it replaces — the snapshots appear here, newest first (the last 10 per version are kept).
sync.restoreBackupHint: Put these files back (the current ones are snapshotted first)
sync.revealBackupHint: Show the backup folder in Explorer
sync.deleteAllBackupsMessage: All {count} backups move to the OS trash.
addons.title: Add-ons
addons.updateChipHint: Newer release {version} available — click to stage the update into every Blender version that has an older copy, then Apply.
addons.updateChipStagedHint: Update to {version} staged — click to cancel.
addons.cellDanglingDisabled: The dangling entry was disabled; its files are still missing
addons.cellDanglingWillRemove:
The dangling entry will be removed after Apply — click to revert
{module}
addons.cellDanglingEnabled:
Enabled in preferences, but its files are missing from disk — click to disable and clean the entry up
{module}
addons.cellCore:
Built into Blender — always on, nothing to toggle
{module}
addons.cellReplaced:
Will be uninstalled and replaced by the version ticked in this column — click to cancel{version}
{module}
addons.cellWillEnable: Will be ENABLED after Apply — click to revert
addons.cellWillDisable: Will be DISABLED after Apply — click to revert
addons.cellDisabled: Installed but disabled — click to enable
addons.installStaged: Will be installed here after Apply — click to cancel
addons.installTick: Not installed — tick to install here on Apply
addons.applyConfirmMessage: Blender {versions} will be launched in the background to install/update add-ons and save preferences. Close any running Blender of these versions first — otherwise it may overwrite the changes.
addons.applyNoteReplaces: Note: some picks replace a version already installed there — the old copy is uninstalled first, then the chosen version is installed.
addons.applyNoteUnsupported: Note: some picks are add-ons Blender dropped (no blender.org replacement). Your old copy will be installed, but it is unsupported and may not work.
addons.applyNoteUndeclared: Note: some picks (reddish squares) target Blender versions the add-on does not declare support for — they will be installed, but may not work.
addons.failUninstallLine: • Blender {minor}: could not remove the old version — {detail}
addons.uninstallDeletePart: delete its files from Blender {minors} and turn it off there
addons.uninstallLibraryPart: remove the stored copy from the Library
addons.uninstallCloseWarning: Close any running Blender of those versions first, or it may be re-saved on exit.
addons.keptLibraryCopy:
Kept the Library copy — some Blender copies were not removed:
{failures}
addons.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app window
addons.addFileTitle: Store a .zip / .py add-on file in the launcher
addons.rescanTitle: Re-read each version’s add-on state (also runs automatically when the page opens); installed add-ons are backed up into the Library along the way — except blender.org extensions, which re-download for free
addons.browserPreviewNote: Browser preview — reading and changing add-ons launches Blender, which only works in the desktop app window.
addons.superhiveDotDisconnected: Not connected — click to connect in Settings
addons.scanIntro: Scan reads which add-ons each installed Blender version has and whether they are enabled — your Library files and Superhive purchases show up here too, ready to install. It reads config files directly (instant); nothing changes until you Apply.
addons.noVersionsInstalled: No installed Blender versions — install one on the Installs tab first, then scan.
addons.emptyAll: Nothing here yet — install add-ons in Blender, add files, or drop them into the window.
addons.emptyUser: Nothing here yet — install add-ons in Blender, or add files with “Add add-on file…”.
addons.emptySuperhive: No Superhive purchases found for your account.
addons.emptySuperhiveConnect: Connect Superhive in Settings to see your purchased extensions here.
addons.rowOnEverywhere: On in every version — click to turn off everywhere
addons.rowTurnOnEverywhere: Turn on in every version — enables it where installed and installs it where missing
addons.removedBadgeTitle: Dropped from Blender, no blender.org replacement — {note}
addons.whatSuperhive: the Superhive build for this Blender
addons.whatBlenderOrg: the extensions.blender.org build for this Blender
addons.hereOnApplyNoSupport: {verb} here on Apply — does not declare support for Blender {minor}, may not work
addons.noDeclaredSupport: This add-on does not declare support for Blender {minor} — it may not work
addons.absentNoSource: No source can install here (e.g. extensions need Blender 4.2+)
addons.absentNotShipped: Blender {minor} does not ship this add-on
addons.absentNothingToInstallFrom: Not installed — no stored file or source to install it from
addons.managedBelow: Managed in the version rows below
addons.revealStored: Show the stored file in Explorer
addons.deleteFromBlenderAndLibrary: Delete from Blender {minors} AND remove the stored Library copy
addons.removeStoredCopy: Remove the stored copy from the Library
addons.cantSwapBuiltin: Blender {minor} ships this add-on built in — can't swap it for {label}
addons.cantInstallInto: {label} can't install into Blender {minor} (e.g. extensions need 4.2+)
